summary: A currency as an asset, so adding Gems is creating a file rather than editing an enum.
overview: Gold, gems, energy — each an asset with a display name, icon and the id used to save balances. Same GameDataAsset pattern as items, so moving Currency standalone means taking that folder too.
useCases: Adding a new currency without touching code.
One asset referenced by the wallet, the shop and the UI.
Currency icons and names in one place.

gotchas.title: The id is what the save file holds
gotchas.body: Renaming the asset is safe; changing its id orphans existing balances.
